entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Technical Support' for product issues or 'Sales' for new orders.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Alex. How can I help you today?
I need to return my VeloBand Pulse. It's not working.
I'm sorry to hear that. I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, is it a technical fault or a preference issue with the band?
It's broken. The heart rate monitor is defective and it won't sync with my phone anymore. I just want to return it.
Okay, I understand. Let me just pull up your account and our return policy. Can I get your order number or the email address associated with your VeloFit account?
It's sam.jones@email.com. Just send me the return label.

One moment, Sam... Okay, I see your order for the VeloBand Pulse HR Monitor. It looks like it was delivered 26 days ago. Let's see... yes, you are well within our 90-day return window. I can absolutely process that for you.
Great. Finally. Just send the label to that email.

Of course. I've just initiated the return. You should receive an email with the prepaid shipping label and instructions within the next 5 minutes. Once we receive the defective unit, we'll issue a full refund to your original payment method. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
